She has a bright personality and avoids fighting if she can. Yamame has brown eyes and blonde hair tied up in a bun with a ribbon. Yamame wears a poofy black and brown dress with eight buttons and gold ribbons crisscrossing over it, black slippers, and white socks.
Yin-yang orbs are Reimu Hakurei's main weapons against humans and youkai, extremely effective against youkai in particular. They were created by Misumaru Tamatsukuri, a god of craftsmanship.

Yatsuhashi Tsukumo is a koto tsukumogami and the younger sister of Benben. Yatsuhashi can produce sounds. She is energetic and more forward than her sister. Yatsuhashi has brown eyes, short brown hair, and a magenta headband with black stripes. Yatsuhashi wears a white shirt with lilac accents, a purple bow at the back of her waist, a black skirt with a purple trim and is barefoot.

Yoshika Miyako is a jiang shi. She can devour anything. Yoshika is the guard of the Hall of Dreams' Great Mausoleum and serves Seiga. She is mindless when under Seiga's orders, but is forgetful and takes everything literally. Yoshika has pale skin, dark blue hair, and eyes. She wears a blue cap with a yellow star, an ofuda on the forehead, a red Chinese-style shirt with pink frills on the sleeves which are also on her black skirt. Yoshika also wears black loafers. Yoshika holds her arms out like a zombie while hopping around.

Youmu Konpaku is a half-phantom half-human, and expert swordswoman. Youmu lives in Hakugyokurou as a servant of Yuyuko. Youmu is straightforward, diligent, but easily manipulated. Youmu has silver eyes, silver hair and a black hairband with a large black ribbon. Her phantom-half manifests as a wisp-shaped ghost following her. She wears a green vest, green skirt, with a white shirt underneath. Youmu dual wields a katana called Roukanken and a wakizashi called Hakurouken.

Youki Konpaku was the first gardener for the Saigyouji clan at Hakugyokurou for about 300 years, before leaving it to his successor and student Youmu Konpaku. He, too, is a half-human half-phantom. No one currently knows his whereabouts. Youki is described as stubborn, prideful and intimidating. While teaching, he preferred not to rely on words; when he did speak, he would only say few words with a thundering voice.
Yukari Yakumo has two youkai crows: Zenki and Goki. She uses them for surveillance.

Yumeko is a demon serving as Shinki's maid and bodyguard in Pandaemonium. She is known to throw swords at her opponents. Yumeko has short curly yellow hair and yellow eyes. She wears a red and white maid uniform.

Yumemi Okazaki is a human professor of the Outside World. She uses artificial magic and works with Chiyuri Kitashirakawa. She is a creator who built the Probability Space Hypervessel and Ruukoto. She studies Magic in Gensokyo, learning how to recreate it artificially. Yumemi has red eyes and dark red hair. She wears a dark red dress and a matching cape.

Yuuka Kazami is a flower youkai. She can manipulate the power of flowers. Yuuka is overwhelmingly powerful and intimidating. She is quite playful but sadistic and likes bullying weaker people. Yuuka is very lazy and rarely leaves Mugenkan in the Garden of the Sun. Elly is her servant. Yuuka has red eyes and shoulder-length green hair. Yuuka wears a white shirt, a red plaid waistcoat and skirt, yellow neckerchief, black pantyhose and brown lace-up boots. She carries a white parasol that can block danmaku.

Yuyuko Saigyouji is a ghost princess. Yuyuko can manipulate death and departed spirits. She is very cheerful, friendly, and is a gourmet. Yuyuko may seem like an airhead, but is actually cunning and smart. She manages the Netherworld and is the mistress of Hakugyokurou. Youmu is her servant and Yukari is her best friend. Yuyuko is the subordinate of Eiki Shiki. Yuyuko has brown eyes and short wavy pink hair. She is surrounded by small spirits. Yuyuko wears a light blue kimono with black trim and spirit motifs, and a blue mob cap.

The Bamboo Forest of the Lost is located opposite of Youkai Mountain relative to Human Village. The layout of forest is constantly shifting. Eientei is found in the Bamboo Forest. Mokou lives there and is not opposed to guiding humans. Kagerou, Tewi and other rabbits live there.
Geidontei is a traditional Japanese style bar located in the Human Village, owned by an old man who makes good stewed vegetables. Miyoi Okunoda works here as the poster girl.

The Great Hakurei Barrier is the shield surrounding all Gensokyo. It was formed in 1885 by the Sages of Gensokyo. With it, Youkai can live peacefully. The only place to get through the barrier is the Hakurei Shrine. You can cross the barrier by being "spirited away".
Heaven is a series of realms. People who have reached nirvana can access it. It can be accessed from the top of Youkai Mountain. Tenshi and Iku live in Heaven.

The Hakurei Shrine is located on East side of Gensokyo. Reimu Hakurei lives there and maintains it. Suika, Aunn, Shinmyoumaru and Ruukoto live there as well. The Shrine is a little run down and rarely gets donations. Reimu occasionally hosts festivals at the Shrine.

Hell is a collection of places to be tortured after death. It is different from Former Hell as all the spirits moved to the New Hell. Hecatia Lapislazuli manages the entirety of Hell as its goddess. The Animal Realm can also be found here.

The Human Village is where most of Gensokyo's Humans live and is the only human settlement. Some youkai come to the village to shop. It's considered the safest place in all of Gensokyo. Outsiders often live here, safe from Youkai. Keine, Akyuu, Kosuzu, Sekibanki, and Miyoi live here.

Misty Lake is a large lake located at the foot of Youkai Mountain. Many fairies and youkai alike appear to gather here, especially during the summertime, given the abundant water. The lake and its environs appear to be the home of Cirno, Daiyousei and Wakasagihime. The Scarlet Devil Mansion and Ruined Western Mansion are near Misty Lake. The Spring Path is also close by.
Moriya Shrine is near the top of Youkai Mountain. It stands next to Wind God's Lake. It is a Shinto shrine that was transported from the outside world. It is the home of Sanae, Kanako, and Suwako.

Muenzuka is located at the end of the Road of Reconsideration. Muenzuka is a small wooded area known for its poisonous, deep red colored spider lilies. It is the graveyard of humans without relatives, or from the Outside World. Treasures from the Outside World tend to float here.

The Myouren Temple Cemetery is found near the Myouren Temple. The Cemetery is very old and holds the entrance into the Hall of Dreams' Great Mausoleum. Kogasa Tatara can be found here, trying to scare people.

The Netherworld is where spirits go after death. It contains lots of ghosts and phantoms. They attack any humans that trespass. Yuyuko and Youmu can be found here, who live in the Hakugyokurou, a ghost shrine known for cherry blossom gardens. The Netherworld is calmer than Hell. Yuyuko manages the Netherworld.

The Palace of the Earth Spirits is in the center of Former Hell. It's a western-style mansion with stained glass windows. Despite the name, there are no spirits there. Satori, Rin and Utsuho live there. Sometimes, Koishi is present.

The Remains of Blazing Hell is under Former Hell. It was a place where criminals were banished to, but now serves as the energy source for the Nuclear Furnace. Rin carts corpses to it while Utsuho powers the Nuclear Furnace.
The Road of Reconsideration is a road where red spider lilies bloom. It's located between the Forest of Magic and Muenzuka.
The Scarlet Devil Mansion is an European style mansion located on the ridge of Misty Lake, next to the Youkai Mountain. This is the home of Remilia, Flandre, Sakuya, Patchouli, Meiling, and Koakuma.

Suzunaan is a traditional Japanese book renter located in the Human Village. The books are normally from the Outside World. Although it is a book lender, they also sell books, and even provide a small book printing service. The Gensokyo Chronicle written by Hieda no Akyuu was also printed and bound here. Kosuzu Motoori works here.
The Untrodden Valley is located at the very base of the Youkai Mountain. It is the hideout of the kappa.
The Underworld is a world under Gensokyo containing Former Hell and the Palace of the Earth Spirits. It can be reached through the Rainbow Cavern of Earth Spirits or the Fantastic Blowhole.

The Youkai Mountain is Gensokyo's biggest mountain and volcano. It has many known locations such as the Wind God's Lake, Moriya Shrine, the Untrodden Valley, and the Great Youkai Forest at the base. It is ruled by the Tengu. A number of gods can also be found on the mountain, Kanako having the highest rank among them.
The Youkai Trail is located near the Human Village. Mystia operates a food stand there to scam humans.

Spell card rules are laws forbidding Gensokyo residents to kill others. They are enforced throughout all of Gensokyo. Breaking them results in extermination. These rules rejects a system where the strongest has the right to rule, and gives humans and weaker youkai a chance to have a word in conflicts.
Danmaku is a barrage of bullets made from magic. To win a danmaku battle, one must dodge or outperform the pattern of projectiles.

Youkai are spiritual beings that survive on belief. They often take on human forms, usually of cute girls. They cannot be defeated by attacks that do not have enough "meaning." Youkai mainly feed on humans or human fear.
Spell cards are powerful magical patterns that enhances the user's attack and defensive abilities for a short time. They are often flashy. Users have to call them out before using them.

Raiko Horikawa is a taiko drum tsukumogami. She can make anything follow a rhythm. She is laid-back and friendly, putting her freedom and that of other tsukumogami above everything else. Raiko has short wavy red hair and red eyes. She wears a black and red flannel shirt tucked in a short white skirt, has a purple tie, a white blazer, short purple boots with red laces and bass drum mallets attached to the heels. She sits on a flying ornate drum kit with a flower pattern.

White wolf tengu are anthropomorphic white wolves with a human body structure. They are the protectors of the Youkai Mountain and will attack trespassers. White wolf tengu are known to be avid players of shogi.
Shinigami are grim reapers. They are tasked to guide spirits to be judged and ferry them across the Sanzu River. Shinigami wield scythes and some can see the life spans of mortals.
Tsukumogami are objects or tools inhabited by a vengeful spirit seeking revenge on the humans that discarded them. Tsukumogami appear as humans carrying the objects they once were.

Moon rabbits are from the moon and are stronger than earth rabbits. They can transform into humans with rabbit ears and use telepathy. Moon Rabbits are seen as tools by Lunarians and are used for farming, making medicine, cleaning and as soldiers. A few fled to Gensokyo.
Kitsune are youkai foxes with up to nine tails. They have incredible magical powers and can shapeshift.
Nekomata are youkai cats with multiple tails. They use necromancy or shamanism and grow more powerful every ten years when they grow a new tail.

Fairies in Gensokyo are playful, mischievous childlike beings. They are born from nature and indestructible, reappearing unless their habitat is destroyed. Fairies are made of pure life force. They come in all shapes and colors based on their element.

Flandre Scarlet is a vampire living in the Scarlet Devil Mansion. She has the power to destroy anything, but does not control that ability well. Flandre is Remilia's little sister. She scares Scarlet Devil Mansion residents due to her unstable behavior, as she was jailed for 495 years by Remilia. Even then, she tries to play with guests, her sister and her servants, sometimes too insistently. Flandre is childlike, innocent and excitable but sassy. Flandre has red eyes, short blonde hair, and a short left sidetail. She wears a red dress and vest, a pink mob cap with red ribbon, and has a pair of rainbow crystal wings.

Ichirin Kumoi is a youkai and Nyuudou user. She has the ability to control Unzan as well as her own danmaku powers. Ichirin is rather mature and tenacious but too eager to see good in people. She guards the Myouren Temple and is one of Byakuren's followers. Ichirin has wavy shoulder-length blue hair and blue eyes. She wears a white and blue dress with a blue veil, a red orb around her neck, and a black and gold Japanese-style kesa she wears over her shoulder. Ichirin also wears white shoes and carries a large golden ring to control Unzan.

Keine Kamishirasawa is a were-hakutaku. She has the power to create history as a human and eat history as a hakutaku. Keine is a teacher and guardian of the Human Village. She is friendly with humans but not youkai and hides her youkai identity. Keine is friends with Mokou. Keine is tall and has silvery blue hair and brown eyes as a human; but silvery green hair and red eyes when in her hakutaku form. Keine wears a blue dress over a white frilly skirt, and a blue hat with a very large red ribbon. In her Hakutaku form, she has horns with a red bow on the left one, and her dress is green.

Komachi Onozuka is a shinigami. She can manipulate distances. Komachi ferries spirits across the Sanzu River and is Eiki's subordinate. Her boat is called the "Titanic." She is lazy, carefree, and chatty. Komachi dislikes when people disrespect Eiki. Komachi is imposingly tall, has red eyes and shoulder-length red hair in two ponytails tied with hair beads. Komachi carries a scythe. She wears a white dress underneath a blue vest, has an obi with a large coin tied to it, and wears platform sandals.

Mononobe no Futo is a Taoist practicing hermit. She can manipulate feng shui and carries a lot of plates to use as weapons. She lives in the Hall of Dreams' Great Mausoleum. Futo is over 1400 years old. She is gentle at heart, but is stuck in the past and talks in an antiquated manner. Futo is a follower of Toyosatomimi no Miko and friendly rivals with Soga no Tojiko. Futo has grey eyes and hair. She wears a pink Heian Era karinginu with a purple skirt. She also wears a distinct eboshi on her head.

Okina Matara is a secret god. She can create doors on the back of anything to manipulate its energy. Okina lives in the Land of the Back Door. She's prideful, and a huge showoff, favoring those who think highly of her. Okina is one of the Sages of Gensokyo. Satono and Mai are her servants. Okina has long, blonde hair and gold eyes. She wears a yellow tabard adorned with a pattern of green stars.

Patchouli Knowledge is a youkai magician. She is very skilled at all types of magic. Patchouli is the librarian of the Scarlet Devil Mansion. Patchouli is a stereotypical shut-in and is not very sociable, but quite witty. She is friends with Marisa, who steals her books regularly, and as a fellow magician, is acquainted with Alice. Koakuma is Patchouli's servant. She is physically weak and asthmatic. Patchouli has long purple hair and purple eyes, wearing a pink nightgown and night cap with a gold crescent moon pin.

Ran Yakumo is a kitsune and shikigami of Yukari. She has a shikigami of her own, Chen, and is very powerful by herself. Ran performs domestic duties for Yukari, and does maintenance on the Great Hakurei Barrier. She is peaceful and gentle. Ran has yellow eyes, short blonde hair, and nine fox tails. Ran is fairly tall. She wears a white dress with purple cuffs and collar, and an indigo tabard with white print. Ran has a light pink two-tipped hat decorated with amulets hiding her fox ears.

Reimu Hakurei is a human shrine maiden. Reimu's duty is to exterminate youkai. She maintains the Hakurei Shrine. Reimu is aloof to strangers, ruthless to enemies; but a great friend. She’s prideful and quite arrogant due to it. She is quick to anger, but she’s also quick to forget. She is responsible for the safety of Gensokyo and maintains balance between humans & youkai. Reimu is Marisa's best friend, rivals with Sanae, and Yukari is her mentor of sorts.

Rin Kaenbyou or "Orin" is a kasha. She can talk to spirits and control vengeful ones. Rin carries corpses to Former Hell's flames using a hand cart. She is positive and energetic. Rin is one of Satori's pets and Utsuho is her best friend. She has black cat ears, red eyes, and fiery red hair tied into twin braids with black ribbons. Rin wears a very dark green dress with green frills, several anklets and a ribbon around her left leg, and black ribbon pumps.

Shinmyoumaru Sukuna is a young inchling princess. She can use the Miracle Mallet and the Shining Needle Sword. Shinmyoumaru lives in the Shining Needle Castle with Seija. Shinmyoumaru acts and speaks like a child and is incredibly gullible. She has short lavender hair and purple eyes and is only a few inches tall. Shinmyoumaru wears a pink kimono with a floral pattern, a black obi and travels around in a floating bowl. She is barefoot.

Sekibanki is a rokurokubi. She can make her head fly or stretch her neck out. Sekibanki lives in the Human Village under the guise of a human. She is a little prideful but avoids people and is rather cynical. She is good friends with Kagerou and Wakasagihime and is a part of the Grassroots Youkai Network. Sekibanki has short red hair and red eyes. Sekibanki wears a red and blue capelet she hides her lower face with, a black and red long sleeved shirt, and a red skirt.

Sunny Milk is one of the Three Fairies of Light. She has the power to refract light to make things invisible. Sunny is very curious about everything, and very energetic. She is Luna's and Star's friend. Sunny has short red hair held in tufty twintails with red ribbons, blue eyes, and a pair of oblong wings. Sunny is rather petite. She wears a red and white dress with many frills, long sleeves, a red obi and a yellow neckerchief, brown shoes, and a white maid headband.

Suika Ibuki is an oni. She can manipulate density and sparseness. She is jolly and childish but immensely strong. Suika enjoys festivals and parties and is always, without exception, drunk. She often stays at the Hakurei Shrine and is friends with Reimu, Yukari, Yuugi and Miyoi. Suika has two long horns on her head with a red ribbon on the left, long brown hair with a large red ribbon in it, and brown eyes. She wears a tattered pale pink blouse, a long purple and pink skirt with flame patterns, cloth bracers and ribbon pumps. Suika carries a large sake gourd. Suika is quite short and petite.

Sumireko Usami is an outsider human. She can use psychic powers and access Gensokyo through her dreams. She has a superiority complex. Sumireko considers Reimu and Marisa her friends and Mokou her friendly rival. Sumireko has brown eyes and messy shoulder-length brown hair. She wears a black hat with a white bow along with under-framed red glasses, a purple plaid skirt and matching sleeveless dress over a white blouse with long sleeves. Sumireko wears a black bolo tie, white gloves, white socks with ribbons, black shoes, black cloak with red, rune-inscribed inner lining, and carries a smartphone that she takes lots of pictures with.

Toyosatomimi no Miko is a saint and hermit. She is the reincarnation of Prince Shoutoku, who spread Buddhism but is now a follower of Taoism. Miko is immortal, can listen to ten conversations at the same time and use Taoist magic. Miko is known to be casual and often jokes around. She lives in the Hall of Dreams' Great Mausoleum or Senkai. Mononobe no Futo and Soga no Tojiko are her followers. Seiga is Miko's taoism mentor. Miko has platinum blonde hair styled like tufty horns and pale brown eyes. She wears purple earmuffs, a white dress over a purple skirt, and a large purple cape. Miko carries her Seven Star Sword.

Wriggle Nightbug is a firefly youkai. She can control other insects. Wriggle is energetic, caring about nature, but very forgetful and easily angered, especially by people who insult insects. Wriggle has blue eyes, teal hair, and bug-like antennae. She wears a white shirt, a black cape with red lining that looks like insect wings, blue shorts, and red shoes.

Yuki is a witch who specializes in fire magic. She lives in Makai in the World of Ice and Snow along with Mai. Yuki has yellow hair and yellow eyes. She wears a dark red hat with a pink ribbon and a dark red and pink dress.

Yukari Yakumo is a unique youkai. She can manipulate the boundaries of anything. Yukari likes to sleep, and enjoys life freely. She is one of the Sages of Gensokyo. Yukari is a manipulative mastermind and is secretive about her real goals. Yukari is friendly towards Reimu but messes with her. Yukari is best friends with Yuyuko, friends with Suika, and Ran is her Shikigami. Yukari is tall and mature-looking. Yukari has gold eyes and very long blonde hair with many red ribbons. She wears a purple tabard with trigrams over a pale pink Western dress with black sleeve cuffs. Yukari wears a pink mob cap with a red ribbon, and usually carries a parasol.

Yuugi Hoshiguma is an oni. She wields the power of unexplained phenomena. Yuugi lives in Former Hell's Hot Spring Town, which she manages. She is very blunt, straightforward, and dislikes weakness. Yuugi's physical strength defies description. Yuugi is Suika's best friend. Yuugi has red eyes, a single long starry red horn on her forehead, and long blonde hair. She wears a white short-sleeved shirt with red trim, a dark blue semi-transparent skirt with red highlights, and geta sandals. Yuugi has broken manacles on her wrists and carries a starry red sake dish that improves any sake poured in it.
Kasha are hell cats who steal corpses from funerals and bring them to the Hell of Blazing Flames as fuel to regulate its heat.

Makai is a location behind the Hakurei Shrine in the mountains. Access to it is sealed, but there are ways to go around it. It is created by Shinki. A toxic miasma fills the air, which is poisonous to normal beings but increases magical power. It houses mostly demons. The Ruins of Vina, Fallen Temple, Makai City, World of Ice and Snow, Pandaemonium, Wonderland, and Hokkai are found in Makai.
The Fallen Temple is located somewhere in Makai. It's a giant broken down temple with a giant crucifix hanging in the lobby. It houses the angel of death Sariel.
The World of Ice and Snow is located somewhere in Makai. It's a barren snowy wasteland with a frozen river running through. Yuki and Mai live around here.
The Wonderland is a location in Makai created in the distant past by Alice Margatroid. Alice visits it sometimes.

Pandaemonium is located in Makai right after the World of Ice and Snow. It's a giant Fortress made of a crystalline material built by and houses Shinki. It's in a devastated state after Shinki lost control.

Ellen is a witch wandering Gensokyo. She looks very young but she's actually immortal while having a childish mindset. Ellen is short, has long blonde hair, and yellow eyes. She wears a red and white dress and a red bow on her head.

Elly is a former shinigami. She is the servant of Yuuka Kazami and gatekeeper of Mugenkan. She's excitable but lonely. Elly uses a scythe to fight. She has curly shoulder-length blonde hair and yellow eyes. Elly wears a pink hat with a red ribbon, a dark red and pink dress and red shoes.

Louise is a demon found in Makai. She's really polite and will often try not to push things too far. She wants to leave Makai. Louise has yellow eyes and short yellow hair. She wears a white hat with a purple birron and a white dress with a purple collar.

Mini-Hakkero is a magical device owned by Marisa Kirisame. It can fire the Master Spark. The Mini-Hakkero is a hand-sized, octagonal piece of wood inscribed with eight Taoist trigrams. Its internal components are made from hihiirokane. It can generate intense heat and magical energy, and the continuous beam it fires looks like a giant laser of rainbow energy.

Kourindou is an antique store owned by Rinnosuke located between the Forest of Magic and the Human Village. It supposedly sells antiques and has an extensive inventory. It is mostly a place to barter for items from the outside world. Kourindou gets very little customers and is rather poorly maintained. Marisa visits Kourindou regularly.
Master Spark is Marisa's signature spellcard. The Master Spark is a gigantic laser beam fired from the Mini-Hakkero. It is incredibly strong and intimidating. The idea was stolen from Yuuka Kazami.
The Purification Rod or "gohei" is owned by Reimu Hakurei. It is used to exterminate youkai. Reimu uses her gohei to fire danmaku.

Kakashi Spirit News is ran by Hatate Himekaidou and is the rival of Bunbunmaru Newspaper. It uses spirit photography, so the articles are very in-depth and informative, but also from the past, so the information is outdated.
Keystones are holy rocks that can suppress earthquakes or cause them. Tenshi rides them and uses them to fight. They are lumps of black granite wrapped with shimenawa ropes.
Lunar veils are pieces of cloth sewn with pure moonlight allowing the wearer to fly around freely, including through space.
Ofuda are talismans for purification, exorcism, or protection in Shinto religion.
Onbashira are blessed wooden pillars that Kanako uses to fight, either as projectiles or as melee weapons.

The Probability Space Hypervessel is a large ship that's capable of time travel. Its captain Yumemi Okazaki and its lone crew member Chiyuri Kitashirakawa used this vessel to travel to Gensokyo in order to prove the existence of magic.
Yama are the judges of life and death of Gensokyo. They judge spirits ferried by shinigami across the Sanzu River. Each Yama has a rod of remorse.
Lord Tsukuyomi is the brother of Amaterasu and lord of the Lunar Capital. He is a few million years old.
Gensokyo's moon is like Earth, with green fields and lakes. Lunarians and Moon Rabbits live in the safety of the Lunar Capital.

The Lunarian Capital is a large city inhabited by the lunarians and moon rabbits. Its technology and weaponry are far more advanced than the Outside World. It is located on the moon. The Lunar Defence Corps is it's military force. It is home to Toyohime, Yorihime, Rei'sen, Sagume and Tsukuyomi.

Watatsuki no Yorihime is a lunarian princess and the younger sister of Toyohime. Yorihime can borrow power from gods, can absorb knowledge and is a superb swordswoman. Yorihime's strength and skills are unmatched by anyone in Gensokyo or the moon. Udongein was her pet and Rei'sen is her current pet. Yorihime respects Eirin as her former teacher. Yorihime is the leader of the Lunar Defense Corps, she is seen as stern and serious. Yorihime has brown eyes and light purple hair tied into a ponytail with a yellow ribbon. She wears a white short-sleeved blouse with a dark red dress over it, golden bracelets, short red boots and a large belt.

Rei'sen is a moon rabbit and the pet of Yorihime and Toyohime. She has the ability to teleport short distances. Rei'sen was formerly a soldier of the Lunar Defense Corps. She is a little shy and easily intimidated. Rei'sen has short light purple hair, red eyes and white fluffy bunny ears. She wears a black business suit, a white shirt, a red tie, a grey skirt, black kneesocks and loafers.
Hell Ravens are found in Hell where they help maintain the Remains of Blazing Hell. They are humanoids with black wings and able to control fire, but are not Tengu.

The Sanzu River is where spirits cross over to the Netherworld by paying a shinigami's boat ride. Komachi Onozuka is the ferrywoman. Only Shinigami and passengers can cross the river, everything else will sink and suffer a horrible fate.

Senkai is an area similar to Gensokyo created Toyosatomimi no Miko for her and her followers. It is a realm where hermits can rest and meditate without being interrupted by others. It's accessed via the principle that any crack contains limitless space, which connects the world to any other location allowing it to be accessed from anywhere.

The Garden of the Sun is located in the heart of Gensokyo. Sunflowers are everywhere in the Garden. Lots of youkai and fairies gather at this spot for concerts or for flower viewing. It's hard to leave the Garden. In the middle of the garden lies Mugenkan. Yuuka, Elly and Eternity Larva can be found here.
The Ruins of Vina are located somewhere in Makai. It used to be a giant castle but now it houses a demon known as Elis.

The Forest of Magic is located near the Human Village. Many magicians live in this forest for the sake of increasing their magical powers with hallucinogenic mushrooms, and it is home to many repulsive things. Ignoring the dangerous environment, it's both a safe and secretive place to seclude oneself, or a fairly nice place to live for people who don't like to be disturbed. Marisa, Alice and Rinnosuke all live in the Forest of Magic.
The Dream World is a world of dreams ruled by the baku. You have to be asleep in order to reach it. Doremy Sweet lives here.

Earth rabbits are natives of Gensokyo often wielding great magic capabilities and the ability to transform into either a rabbit or a girl with rabbit ears. Tewi leads the earth rabbits. They live in the Bamboo Forest of the Lost. They have allied themselves with the residents of Eientei and work there.
Nue are chimera-like youkai and extremely rare in Gensokyo. They are able to make themselves and other objects unrecognizable to the point that they looks like something completely different.
Wind God's Lake is located on top of the Youkai Mountain, next to Moriya Shrine. It has holy properties.
The Canal of Willows is a forest of willow trees located near the Human Village. It's said to be peaceful as there are rarely any youkai wandering the area.

Higan is on the other side of the Sanzu River. Higan has no night or day, no weather, and no seasons. It is an endless expanse of flowers with gentle warmth. Higan is a place where departed souls are judged by Eiki Shiki. Komachi Onozuka lives here. Kutaka Niwatari works here as the gatekeeper.

Mayohiga is an abandoned village located near the Great Hakurei Barrier somewhere in the mountains. Humans tend to stumble across it when they try to leave Gensokyo without using the Hakurei Shrine. Taking something from Mayohiga gives good luck. Cats live in Mayohiga because Chen brings them there.

Hatate Himekaidou is a crow tengu living on Youkai Mountain. She can use spirit photography to see things from somewhere else. Her articles are less sensationalist than Aya's, who is her rival. Hatate is really lazy but chipper and friendly. She is a shut in and rarely leaves home. Hatate has brown eyes and brown hair in pigtails with purple ribbons. She wears a pink shirt with a frilly collar, black tie, a purple tokin, a checkered purple and black skirt, and geta sandals.

Mamizou Futatsuiwa is a bake-danuki. She can disguise herself or things around her. Mamizou is mischievous but good-natured and quite responsible. She lives in the Tanuki Forest, is a guest of the Myouren Temple and a friend of Nue. She lends money to poor humans. Mamizou has brown eyes, light brown shoulder-length hair, tanuki ears, and a giant, fluffy striped tail. She wears a green leaf on her head, and glasses. Mamizou wears a pink shirt with a leather apron, a skirt striped like her tail, and carries a bottle of sake.
Hakugyokurou is a ghost shrine located in the Netherworld. The youkai cherry tree Saigyou Ayakashi is dormant in its gardens. Hakugyoukurou is the home of Yuyuko and Youmu.
The Youkai Tanuki Forest is located near the Human Village. The Youkai Tanuki Forest houses all sorts of youkai and tanuki. Mamizou Futatsuiwa can be seen around there.

The Lake of Blood is a lake in the mountains that appears to be filled with pure blood, rather than water. Within it lies the entrance to Mugenkan. Kurumi is the gatekeeper of the entrance to the lake. Elly stands guard within the lake, at the border between Gensokyo and the Fantasy World, protecting the entrance to Mugenkan.

Lyrica Prismriver is a poltergeist keyboardist and the third Prismriver sister. Her music enhances the effect of Merlin's and Lunasa's. She lazy and crafty. Lyrica has brown eyes and short light brown hair. Her red keyboard is always nearby. She wears red clothing dress with pink and black trimming over a white shirt, red shorts, and a red hat with a green star decoration. She's the shortest Prismriver sister.

Mai Teireida is an immortal human. Mai can increase a person's physical energy by dancing behind them. She lives in the Land of the Backdoor, working for Okina with her partner Satono. Mai is scatterbrained and impulsive but serves Okina unquestioningly. She has short dull green hair with two long side locks, and green eyes. Mai wears a kazaori-eboshi, a green dress with short sleeves, a white half apron and collar with red frills and a yellow bow, black kneesocks, and green shoes. She holds a bamboo stalk.
The Land of the Back Door is a dimension ruled and created by Okina. It's filled with floating doors that can lead to any location in Gensokyo. Satono and Mai live there.

The Nameless Hill is located on the opposite side of the Youkai Mountain and halfway up a small mountain. It is a meadow filled with purple and white lilies-of-the-valley which are poisonous. Medicine Melancholy lives there.
The Outside World is modern-day Earth, which is separate from Gensokyo. It is technologically advanced but lacks faith and belief. Gensokyo is closest in culture to old Japan.
The Nuclear Furnace is located in the deepest parts of the Underworld. It creates nuclear fusion energy for power and heat. Kanako and Suwako built the Nuclear Furnace. Utsuho powers it.

The Underground Geyser Center is a research facility and located in the deepest parts of the Underworld. It is connected to the Nuclear Furnace. Kappa and the gods of the Moriya Shrine use it for research.
The Shining Needle Castle is located in the sky near Youkai Mountain. It was created by the Miracle Mallet a long time ago. It is the home to Shinmyoumaru and other inchlings.
Eientei is a traditional Japanese mansion located in the Bamboo Forest. Its corridors sprawl endlessly. Kaguya is its mistress. It includes a clinic where Eirin works. It is home to Reisen & Tewi.

Kyouko Kasodani is a yamabiko. She can reflect sounds. She is a Buddhist priestess-in-training at the Myouren Temple and in a band with Mystia. Kyouko is cheerful, dutiful, and energetic but has a bit of a rebellious streak. She has teal hair and teal eyes along with brown dog ears. Kyouko wears a long pale pink dress with teal flower ornaments, a white dress under it with a black trim, and black shoes. She has a short tail and carries a bamboo broom.

The Myouren Temple was originally a ship. It rests atop the Hall of Dream's Great Mausoleum and has been turned in a Buddhist Temple. It is also called the "Palanquin Ship." Byakuren can make it fly. This is the home of Byakuren, Shou, Nazrin, Ichirin, Murasa, Nue, Kyouko and Mamizou. Koishi and Jo'on can be found here occasionally.

Marisa Kirisame is a human witch. She uses heat and light magic and receives power from the mini-hakkero. She lives in the Kirisame household in the Forest of Magic. Marisa enjoys finding mushrooms and stealing things she finds interesting. She is outgoing, informal, and loves action. Marisa is friends with Nitori, Alice and Patchouli. Reimu is Marisa's best friend. Marisa's signature attack is "Master Spark". Marisa has blonde hair and yellow eyes. She wears a black vest and skirt, white apron and shirt. Marisa has a black witch hat with white ribbons, and flies on a magic broom.

The Genbu Ravine is located near Youkai Mountain and Forest of Magic. The bottom looks like turtleshell. It's surrounded by six-sided cliffs, and a waterfall drops into a lake at the bottom. Nitori lives near the Ravine.

The Animal Realm is a skyscraper-filled metropolis located in Hell, with a forest known as the Primate Spirit Garden. The Animal Realm is filled with animal spirits and is a harsh environment relying on survival of the fittest. The animal spirits rule, and enslave human spirits. Notable leaders are Yachie and Saki.

Gensokyo is a place located somewhere around the Yatsugatake Mountains in Japan. It's a land of illusions: it is hidden from the Outside World, and surrounded by the Great Hakurei Barrier. Gensokyo's inhabitants are mainly creatures of Japanese Folklore and humans. Gensokyo is surrounded by Great Hakurei Barrier. Everyone speaks Modern Japanese. The technology in Gensokyo is similar to 1880s-era Japan.

The Hall of Dreams' Great Mausoleum is located under the Myouren Temple and is entered through a cave. It was the tomb of Toyosatomimi no Miko where she was sealed by Buddhist monks, but now serves as her home for her and her followers.
Rods of Remorse are carried by every Yama. It is used to beat sinners until they repent.

Eiki Shiki is a Yama living in Higan. Eiki is the Judge of the Dead for the Ministry of Right and Wrong. She has power to judge others using the Rod of Remorse and the Cleansed Crystal Mirror. Yuyuko is Eiki's subordinate. Eiki often scolds her servant Komachi. Eiki serves Hecatia. She is known to scold and lecture others, but does so with goodwill. Eiki has short green hair swept to the right and blue eyes. She wears a blue and white hat with a gold emblem, a blue and black uniform, and black shoes with red bows.

The Ministry of Right and Wrong is the organization that manages the afterlife. They decide who goes to Heaven or Hell. Hecatia Lapislazuli is the leader of Ministry. Eiki judges the souls of those who died and the Kishin hunt those who live too long.

Iku Nagae is an oarfish youkai. Iku has the power to read the mood of a place and perfectly adapt to it. She can cause storms using the Dragon God's power. Iku is the envoy of the Dragon Palace and lives in Heaven. She is loyal to celestials and Dragon Palace residents, and is Tenshi's friend. Iku is focused on her duties and is rather calm and businesslike. Iku has red eyes and blue hair. She wears a white and red frilly shirt, a long black skirt, and a black round hat with a very long red ribbon. Iku has a long white and red shawl along her arms and chest.

Nazrin is a mouse youkai. She can find anything she is tasked to look for. She lives in a shack on the Nameless Hill and leads a large flock of mice. Nazrin a skilled dowser, but is full of herself and easily frightened. She was sent by Bishamonten to watch over Shou and her Pagoda. Nazrin has short gray hair and red eyes, mouse ears and a thick mouse tail. She wears a black sleeveless dress with rectangular cutouts at the bottom, a white undershirt and a dull blue capelet. Nazrin wears black slippers, a crystal pendant, and carries two dowsing rods.
The Deep Road to Hell leads to Former Hell. It's green and gloomy. Parsee roams around here.
The Fantastic Blowhole is a location in the Underworld near the Deep Road to Hell. It's a cave that is always wet with a very strong wind. Kisume and Yamame live there.

Chang'e is a lunarian who was the mistress of all moon rabbits. She is now a prisoner on the moon for her entire immortal lifetime after drinking the Hourai Elixir. Junko has a major grudge against Chang'e for killing Junko's son. Hecatia Lapislazuli has a grudge against Chang'e since Chang'e's husband destroyed the suns that balanced the darkness of Hell.

Hot Spring Town is a resort in Former Hell. It is accessible from the Rainbow Cavern of Earth Spirits, and managed by Yuugi. Hot Spring Town has densely packed traditional Japanese houses. Hot steamy water constantly pours from up above. There are large hot springs everywhere, which oni and vengeful spirits use to bathe.

Sanae Kochiya is a shrine maiden. She can perform miracles and can summon Suwako or Kanako. Sanae is confident, energetic, and dutiful. She considers Reimu her rival, but also a friend. Sanae lives at and tends to the Moriya shrine. She has green eyes, and long green hair. Sanae wears a white and blue shrine maiden outfit with detached sleeves. She has a frog pin, and a long white snake decoration in her hair. Sanae also wears white kneesocks and black loafers. She is a descendant of Suwako.

Aya Shameimaru is a crow tengu reporter. She has power to manipulate wind. Aya is one of the strongest tengu, and one of the fastest. Aya lives somewhere on Youkai Mountain. She always looks for gossip, relying on aggressive reporting tactics and is prone to exaggerate. While Aya actually cares about the truth, she is somewhat full of herself. Aya runs a newspaper called the Bunbunmaru. She is Hatate's rival. Aya has red eyes and shoulder-length black hair. She wears a white blouse with a black ribbon, black skirt, red geta sandals and a red tokin. She usually carries a camera.
Bake-danuki are youkai tanuki. They have the ability to transform and disguise themselves as objects or other species. Bake-danuki can also transform leaves into other objects.
Were-hakutaku are humans with the ability to turn into a hakutaku on a full moon. Hakutaku are bovine youkai who bring good fortune and give sage advice.

Hakurouken is an ancestral wakizashi of the Konpaku family. Only Konpaku family members can wield it. Youmu owns it. It erases doubt from humans on attack. Ghosts achieve nirvana when cut by Hakurouken.

Jiang shi are zombie youkai that move by hopping around and can turn other humans into Jiang Shi by biting them. The zombification will only be permanent if the bite is fatal. They have stiff limbs and cannot think for themselves, usually following a master.
The Barrier of Life and Death is located in the sky and separates Gensokyo and the Netherworld. It takes the shape of a colossal door.
The Spring Path is a long mysterious path full of flowers and cherry blossom located near Misty Lake and the Forest of Magic.

Chiyuri Kitashirakawa is a human not native to Gensokyo. She can use artificial magic, is a bit excitable, and will often make situations much worse than they already are. Chiyuri has blonde hair and yellow eyes. She wears a white sailor uniform with a shade of blue which looks too small for her and a blue neckerchief. Chiyuri commands the Probability Space Hypervessel. She assists Yumemi Okazaki.

Former Hell is a region in the Underworld that used to be Hell. Due to overpopulation, the Yama moved Hell to a different location. It is accessed by the Deep Road to Hell, guarded by Parsee. The Palace of the Earth Spirits is found here. This place is the home of Yuugi, Satori, Koishi, Utsuho, and Rin.

Hisoutensoku is a nuclear powered mecha created by the kappa. It resembles a giant golden robot. It is used for advertising the Future Water Youkai Bazaar, but is often confused for all sorts of monsters.

The Road of Liminality is located at the back of the Youkai Mountain and is connected to the Sanzu River. Harmless ghosts roam around, and both youkai and humans built stands to sell their wares here.

The Primate Spirit Garden is a large park resembling a kofun burial mound, located in the Animal Realm. Part of it was transformed into a high-tech fortress by Keiki Haniyasushin. The animal spirits are trying to take back this region but are unable to defeat the Haniwa Army Corps defending it. Keiki and Mayumi live here.
The Jeweled Pagoda of Bishamonten is a spherical gem held in a pagoda-shaped case. It is owned and used by Shou. It can fire powerful laser beams. If shot at the ground, it will turn it into gems.
The Great Youkai Forest is located at the base of the Youkai Mountain. It's a forest known to block out sunlight allowing most youkai to live there in peace.

Matenshi is an angel residing in Makai. She has purple hair at medium length and purple eyes. Matenshi wears a blue dress with a blue apron that has a white cross design on it. She also has angel-like wings. She is known to be hostile to humans.
The Prismriver Sisters are Lunasa, Merlin and Lyrica. They form "the Phantom Ensemble". The Prismriver Sisters play concerts throughout Gensokyo. They live in the Ruined Western Mansion with Layla.

Saigyou Ayakashi is a youkai cherry tree living in Hakugyokurou. The Saigyou Ayakashi has a lot of dead bodies buried under it to seal its cherry blossoms. It drains life from those under its canopy. If it blooms, it will cause mass death.

Roukanken is a long-bladed katana created by youkai and wielded by Youmu Konpaku. Youmu likes to boast about the power of this sword, usually exclaiming "The things that cannot be cut by my Roukanken, forged by youkai, are close to none!". Supposedly, it can kill ten spirits with one stroke. The sheath is decorated with a flower and ofuda.
The Soul Torch is a small paper lantern which attracts phantoms when lit. It is used by Yuyuko Saigyouji. She can light or extinguish the torch from any distance.

The Miracle Mallet is a magical tool wielded by Shinmyoumaru. The Miracle Mallet can change the size of anything with its powers or grant the wielder's wish at the cost proportional to the scale of the wish. The Miracle Mallet can only be wielded by the inchlings.

The Sword of Hisou looks like a burning-red jian. It is wielded by Tenshi Hinanawi. It has the power to identify one's spirit, can cut through anything and use spirit energy. It can only be used and summoned by Tenshi.

Sagume Kishin is a lunarian divine spirit. Her ability reverses the course of any situation she speaks about. She speaks very little because of her ability, but is sharp and logical. Sagume has red eyes, short light grey hair with a princess braid around her head and a single angel wing on her back. She wears a purple dress whose bottom cuts off in an arrow pattern, a red microphone bowtie, a tan jacket with black alchemical symbols, and brown shoes.

Watatsuki no Toyohime is a lunarian princess and older sister of Yorihime. Toyohime possesses incommensurate luck, power, and can manipulate the physical and conceptual boundaries of the Moon and Earth, as well as mountains and seas. Toyohime has a gentle personality but is rather aloof. Udongein was her pet and Rei'sen is her current pet. Toyohime respects Eirin as her former teacher. She has long flowing blonde hair and golden eyes. Toyohime wears a white long-sleeved blouse with a blue dress over it, a loose belt, short purple boots and a white mobcap with a purple ribbon. She wields a fan that can purify things to the atomic level.

Unzan is a nyuudou or enlightened spirit who follows and guards Ichirin. He can make his fists grow to a massive size or shoot danmaku. Unzan takes the appearance of a pinkish cloud with the face of an angry old man, but he is quite shy and prefers that Ichirin speak on his behalf. Even then, he gives her insight when needed.
The Grassroots Youkai Network is a loose group of weaker and more docile youkai. They help each other and trade information.

Mike Goutokuji is a female calico Maneki-Neko. She has the power to bring either money or customers to a shop, but not both at once. She lives near Youkai Mountain. Mike loves haggling but prefers lazing around. She was rejected by other Maneki-Neko because she is a calico. Mike has short brown-orange-white hair, a cat tail and cat ears, and orange eyes. She wears a white shirt and skirt with brown and orange patches, leather bracelets and a choker with a gold bell. Mike carries a good luck koban coin and is barefoot.
Maneki-nekos are catpeople that bring good fortune to businesses. They are usually pure white but exceptions exist and are often rejected by the others.

Yamawaro are similar to Kappa but live in mountainous areas and thick forests rather than near bodies of water. They are rivals with Kappas. Yamawaros depend on Kappa technology but are better businesspeople.

Takane Yamashiro is a yamawaro living in the Youkai Mountain's forests. She has the ability to manipulate the Qi of the forest. Takane is more amiable than average yamawaro, and a good businesswoman. She is wary of humans but manages the Moriya Shrine cable car. Takane has fluffy shoulder-length green hair and dark green eyes. She wears a dark green camouflage dress with many pouches, a dark blue camo cap and brown boots. Takane carries a briefcase on her back with the key around her neck.

Sannyo Komakusa or Komakusa-dayuu is a yamajorou. She can manipulate minds with her pipe's smoke. Sannyo owns a gambling den on the Youkai Mountain. She is blunt and rough-spoken and a skilled manipulator. Sannyo has purple hair in a ponytail tied with a yellow bow, and red eyes. Sannyo wears a lavish purple kimono dress, a red vest with gold filigree and geta sandals. She carries a golden fan and a dragon-shaped smoking pipe.

Misumaru Tamatsukuri is a god. She can craft magatama from dragon gems and rare magical minerals. Her power lets her store abilities, emotions and memories in magatama. She crafted Reimu's Yin-yang orbs. Misumaru cares deeply about people and the environment. Misumaru has brown eyes and blonde and brown hair with a headband and hair ties decorated with dragon gems. She wears a red shirt with a purple vine pattern and white puffy sleeves, a yellow dress with a green vine pattern and a purple sash. Misumaru's clothing is decorated with many rainbow magatama. She is barefoot.

Tsukasa Kudamaki is a kuda-gitsune. She can use her power to find weak spots in people's souls. Tsukasa is trusted by many for her useful advice but is highly manipulative and mean-spirited. She is Megumu's right-hand woman. She has neck-length blonde hair,yellow eyes, blonde fox ears with white tips and a fox tail. Tsukasa wears a short white cheongsam with mint green laces and a plant design, white tabi socks and carries a test tube around.

Megumu Iizunamaru is a great tengu. She can manipulate the starry sky. She is one of the leaders of Youkai Mountain's tengu. She speaks respectfully but cares only for her position in the tengu hierarchy. Tsukasa and Chimata are her associates. Megumu has dark blue hair and red eyes. She wears a blue dress, a black coat with a jeweled gold pauldron and white puffs at the bottom, a blue tokin hat, black socks & purple geta sandals. She wields a camera tripod as a bludgeon.

Chimata Tenkyuu is a god of the marketplace. She can transfer the ownership of things from one person to another, including concepts or abilities. Chimata is polite but somewhat dramatic in her behavior, and very strung up on the rules of barter market. She hates profit-seekers, preferring those who wish to share the value of things. She is Megumu's and Tsukasa's associate. Her eyes and hair look like a dark sky. She wears a dress with sections of all colors of the rainbow connected by zippers, magenta boots and a cape whose inside looks like daytime sky.

Momoyo Himemushi is an oomukade. Her ability lets her devour dragons. She lives in the Rainbow Dragon Cave and mines Dragon Gems. Momoyo is incomprehensibly strong and emits deadly toxins, and thus respects anyone who dares approach her. Momoyo speaks in a very masculine manner. She works for Megumu. Momoyo has very messy gray hair and eyes. She wears a black shirt and skirt with gold swirls lined with many jade rings. Momoyo has many orange ribbons tied around her arms and legs, an orange sash around her waist and is barefoot. She carries a golden shovel and pickaxe.

Tokiko is a crested ibis youkai. She is weak and has no special abilities. Tokiko is curious and loves to read, often visiting places with large amounts of books. She has white hair with a blue front tuft and side bangs, small pointy blue horns, and red eyes. She wears a blue and black gothic dress with wide white sleeves, a large blue ribbon and black boots.

The Child of Miare is the reincarnation of Hieda no Are and the keeper of Gensokyo's knowledge. They live for a very short time but keep memories of their previous lives and are unable to forget things they see.

Yuuma Toutetsu is a Taotie. She has the ability to swallow anything and absorb it, and can also "eat" attacks. Yuuma is the head of the Gouyoku Alliance, and a rival of Saki and Yachie. Yuuma lives in the Animal Realm and visits the Sea of Petroleum and Abandoned Hell of Blood Pools for power. Yuuma is greedy and opportunistic. Yuuma has fluffy white hair like wool, and slitted red sheep eyes. She has long, pointy ears with gold earrings, and big red ram horns decorated with blue ribbons. Yuuma wears a blue dress with white patterns similar to Chinese bronzework and short red sleeves with exposed shoulders, a bronze talisman around her neck, and is barefoot. Yuuma carries a massive spoon she uses as a weapon.
The Gouyoku Alliance is an organization in the Animal Realm led by Yuuma Toutetsu and a rival to Yachie and Saki's organizations. They represent greed.
The Sea of Petroleum is a location in Hell which is filled with oil. It connects to the Abandoned Hell of Blood Pools. Yuuma Toutetsu frequents it to acquire power.
The Abandoned Hell of Blood Pools is a former Hell that contains pools that represents different sins. Yuuma Toutetsu uses these pools to power herself up.
A Taotie is a type of evil beast in Chinese mythology. They have sheeplike features and are creatures of corruption and greed.
The Rainbow Cavern of Earth Spirits is an underground passage located in the Forest of Magic, leading to the Hot Spring Town in Former Hell. Yamame sometimes lurks around.
Yukari, Okina and Kasen are the currently known sages of Gensokyo, and help maintain the Great Hakurei Barrier.

The Sorcerer's Sutra Scroll is an infinite scroll that only Hijiri Byakuren can wield. It contains an unlimited amount of spells and does not deteriorate. It can cast spells on its own, or enhance Hijiri's.
Omukade are youkai giant centipedes. Oomukade live under mountains and reach colossal sizes. They are rumored to be dragon-eaters and are assumed to be tremendously strong as a result.
The Shining Needle Sword is a magical needle used by Shinmyoumaru. It can fire beams from its tip and acts as a focus for her magic.
The Keiga Family is an organization in the Animal Realm led by Saki Kurokoma and a rival to Yachie and Yuuma's organizations. They represent brute force.
The Kiketsu Family is an organization in the Animal Realm led by Yachie Kicchou and a rival to Saki and Yuuma's organizations. They represent conniving and conspiring.

Mizuchi Miyadeguchi is a vengeful spirit. She can possess anyone regardless of strength. Mizuchi lives in Hell but roams Gensokyo in search of victims. She collects magical trinkets, and stalks Reimu to cause her trouble. Mizuchi has dark blue eyes and dark blue hair that fades to deep green in a ponytail, with two short braids to the sides and hairpins shaped like bundles of little ghosts. Mizuchi wears a black and white striped shirt and skirt over a short black dress. Mizuchi's legs stop at the thighs and dissipate into bluish mist. Her gloves have handcuffs with broken chains. Mizuchi has a very large handcuff around her neck, and uses the opposite cuff to catch possession victims.

entries.name: Possessiveness
entries.content:
A possessive individual is someone who believes they own something. Possession is often related to a person, which makes possessiveness something dangerous in the sense of limiting the freedom of another human being. Possessive jealousy is the manifestation of the feeling of possession and exclusivity in relation to another person.

In yanderes, the possessivess manifests when they see the people which they love is with another person, and then, the possessive (yandere) will be jealous and insecure for thinking that their loved person will be taken by another one.

entries.name: Jealously
entries.content:
Unhealthy jealousy generates a need for possession and control of your partner and, above all, control of that person's behavior and feelings. Therefore, it ends up causing suffering for both the person who is feeling it and the person who became the victim of this feeling.

In yanderes, this is the fuel to make their minds go far, making them have paranoid thoughts whican be far from reality, and also, make them do many insane things, such as kill people which the yandere think that will "steal" their most loved one. Or, kidnap their loved one to have they as a captive.

entries.name: Yandere
entries.content:
Yandere simply means that the person feels an unhealthy love for another and would be capable of killing, usually due to jealousy or fear, any "obstacle" to being with that loved one. Some characters also tend to demonstrate suicidal tendencies.

Yanderes are know for going beyond the limits of the common sense just because of "love", consequently guiding the Yandere on doing things which is saw as "insane" and Non-sensical, such as dismember corpses, rape, or creating lies to isolate their "loved ones", or victims, for those who is not deluded by the excessive love.

A frequent ocurrence with Yanderes is stalking their victims at the point of invading their personal spaces, and also, in some of these cases, the Yandere can took photos or watch silently their victim with admiration, despite this being bizarre.

"Yandere" is a term for someone who at first is very sweet, loving, innocent, and overly affectionate like a normal deredere, but over time begins exhibiting signs of being mentally sick as a result of having a too strong love. Their love, admiration, and devotion to their love interest is so strong that it causes them to gradually develop an unstable mental state. They are the kind of character who will act all deredere and lovey-dovey when their relationship with their romantic partner is going well, but when something triggers jealousy or possessiveness they act impulsively in a way that makes them seem mentally ill. Their love is expressed as an excessive obsession and possessiveness towards their love interest. They become so attached to their love interest that it's impossible to let go and they may begin doing immoral things such as stalking their love interest or even using violence as a last resort towards anyone who "threatens" their relationship. They entrust themselves to their love interest, trusting in their love interest's kindness. They probe the deepest recesses of their love interest's heart to more perfectly form their greatest self within their love interest.

Yandere is unique when compared to most dere types in that it does not start as "__" (an unromantic state) and then becomes "dere" over time resulting in the more traditional tsundere formula: "sick at the start" and "dere at the end". Rather a yandere is already deredere from the very start. They are openly affectionate, romantic, and legitimately kind, loving, innocent, and sweet just like a regular deredere character is, however, over time they begin exhibiting signs of extreme jealousy, outbursts of rage, or strong feelings of possession. They are a character who is so deredere (lovestruck) that it causes them to become mentally sick (yan) and to express their love in unhealthy ways. It is a sickness born from too much love.

The point of yandere is that they aren't a yandere from the beginning and that they don't realize they are sick. When a boy they like is talking to another girl, they feel a little jealousy. It's rare to start getting sick just because of that event, but they'll gradually become a yandere over time. The more they think about the person they like, the more they "like" them, and their desire to monopolize becomes very strong. The reason for this is that they always think that they are the same because they are always delusional about becoming a lover or being married. "But he's mine..." and out of love, their possessiveness becomes very strong. Many people have the image that yandere are scary, but there are also many cases where they realize the magnitude of the love and become obsessed, thinking, "I can't believe she cares about me that much!" It's important for a yandere girl to love as much as she can!

Their love is expressed as an excessive obsession and possessiveness towards their love interest. They become so attached to their love interest that it's impossible to let go and they may even use violence as a last resort towards anyone who "threatens" their relationship. They are not characters who 'want' to do this crazy actions or to commit violent acts, but they be become so scared of losing their love interest that they act out of impulse.

A yandere may have some pre-existing feelings, such as loneliness or loss, that explain why they hold on so tightly to the first person to make them love again. Those feelings they had prior to falling in love are then made even worse by their strong feelings towards their love interest and they develop a strong desire to never go back to that feeling that way so it causes them to become scared of anything that threatens to disrupt their happiness. In many cases though they were simply a perfectly normal healthy person prior to falling in love. Their may not have been any warning signs that their love will develop into an unhealthy obsession, but overtime their love starts to become too strong and it causes a change in the character. Whatever the case may be, the main action that causes a yandere character to develop an unstable mental state and change from "dere" (lovestruck and overly affectionate) to "yan" (mentally sick) is their excessive love. They are a mentally sick character who harbors deredere feelings towards their love interest and they will do anything it takes to be with them.

Despite their seemingly insane personality they are not characters who like to, or even want to, commit violent acts. They are simply characters who are deeply insecure and prone to negative thoughts so feel they have no other choice so they act entirely on impulse. At the same time they are characters that can be stopped and brought back to their senses by their love for their romantic partner. If their love interest were to ensure them or say they love the yandere it can make them snap back to their senses and switch back to "dere" mode, dropping their weapon in the process even when they completely intent on using it just moments prior. They may also stop themselves from committing violent acts because they don't want their love interest to dislike them for it.

Exists many types of Yanderes, such as "depedant", "violent", "worshipping", "delusional", "attacking", "stalking", "isolating", "monopolizing", "eliminating", and more.

Yanderes sometimes put drugs on drinks for their victims faint. When the victims are doped, the Yanderes usually kidnap the victim to take them to another place, like a basement.

entries.name: Most Insane
entries.content:
The most dangerous type of Yandere in the the extreme ones. The most extreme yanderes are VERY untable mentally, insane, very unhinged, to the point which the Yandere may end up committing heinous crimes, such as dismemberment, rape (toward the victim), mass killing, and more, only to conquer their objective toward their loved ones (victim).

The victim of the Yandere may be even forced to satisfy their insane yandere pleasures, since the yandere WANTS. So, in some cases, the victim can happen to be raped by their yandere, like: "The yandere (girl) rape the victim (boy) to be pregnant of him, and, to be with him forever and also have "a part" of the victim forever with her". Very bizarre.

entries.name: Satori Komeiji
entries.content:
[SATORI CAN'T PERCEIVE KOISHI WITH THE THIRD EYE! KOISHI CAN'T THINK, MAKING SATORI POWER USELESS AGAINST KOISHI.]

Some of Satori spell cards example are: {{Recollection "Terrible Souvenir"}}; {{Recollection "Terrifying Hypnotism"}; {{Recollection "Double Black Death Butterfly"}}; {{Recollection "Flying Insect's Nest"}}; {{Heart Flower "Camera-Shy Rose"}}; {{Brain Sign "Brain Fingerprint"}}; {{Earth Spirit Sign "Mind Stellar Steal" (Co-owner with Utsuho)}}; {{"Perfect Mind Control"	(Co-owner with Koishi)}}; {{Earth Ghostly Sign "Shikigami of the Ego"	(Co-owner with Ran Yakumo)}}.]



1º ("Satori Appearance")= {{Satori has short, purple hair with a black hairband and purple eyes. A red "third eye" is positioned over her heart, with cords running to her head and wrists. Wears a blue shirt with yellow heart buttons and pink collar, a pink skirt with faint flowery pattern and pink slippers.

Satori has purple wavy neck-length hair with a black hairband with a yellow heart-shaped keychain attached and has brilliant purple eyes. She has an red "third eye" is positioned over her heart, with cords wrapped around her torso and attached to each of her ankles. She wears a light-blue shirt that reaches to her wrists with heart-shaped yellow buttons and a light-pink collar. The skirt is also light-pink with a faint flowery pattern, but is lighter. Her socks are white that reaches to her ankles and wears pinkish-red slippers.}}

2º ("Satori Personality")= {{Satori, as her own name says, shows that she is a Demon who can read the minds of others, and this make everyone ear her, and also meking her kinda alone, but at least she has alot of animals that is her pets, even Utsuho and Rin Kaenbyou, that although they isn't "animal" Utsuho is a humanoid youkai crow, and Rin is humanoid youkai cat, and both are Satori servants.

Satori actually is 4,276 years old (physically 19 years old). As a demon she is far more durable than a human would be, along with having enhanced speed and strength.

Satori Komeiji is the Mistress of the Palace of the Earth Spirits after the underground city was separated from Hell. She barely gets any visitors because her ability to read minds makes various youkai and spirits fear her, while leaving her well-loved by the animals that normally can't be understood. With these animals as pets, she manages the ruins of inferno where her home stands.

Satori is quiet and calm, afterall almost no one speaks with her for fear, except her little sister, that is Koishi Komeiji, that unlike Satori, Koishi is considered mindless for her actions be controled by her emotions and instincts, making her do what her emotions want, and Koishi acts like a very happy child, even if she is 300 years old, in other words, Koishi is very crazy. And also unlike Satori, the third eye of Koishi that is also attached to her corpse with a long rope is closed, and Satori third eye is open, and because Satori third eye is open, she can read and do hypnosis, and Koishi not.}}

entries.name: Koishi Komeiji
entries.content:
1º ("Koishi Komeiji")= {{Koishi Komeiji is Satori Komeiji's younger sister. She wanted to avoid the hate and dislike which Satori experienced due to their mindreading abilities, so she sealed away her own Third Eye. This backfired, since she gained the ability to read and manipulate people's subconscious, an even greater ability. However, she also became much more carefree as a result, and didn't mind as much.

She now spends much of her time wandering the world aimlessly. After her encounter with the heroine in Subterranean Animism's Extra Stage however, she became curious, and wanted to start actually meeting people. 

After the events of Symposium of Post-mysticism, Byakuren Hijiri solicited Koishi into her faction as a laywoman.

Koishi had stolen Kokoro's mask of hope, causing them to grow a severe hatred for each other.

Koishi has wavy, grey-greenish, short hair and dark green eyes, wears a black hat with a yellow ribbon around it. A closed, dark blue "third eye" is positioned over her heart, with cords wrapped around her torso and attached to each of her ankles. Wears a yellow shirt with diamond-like blue buttons and dark green collar. The skirt is also green with a faint flowery pattern, but a lot lighter. Her socks are black.

Koishi power is Manipulate the Subconsciousness.

Koishi is generally playful and free-spirited, not unlike a child. While her ability to manipulate the unconscious makes her presence unsettling to many people, she seems unconcerned with appearing scary, and does whatever feels right in the moment. She does not seem to go out of her way to harm others out of malice or spite, although she has occasionally caused issues for other characters due to a lack of self-awareness, such as in her accidentally stealing Hata no Kokoro's mask in Hopeless Masquerade, or Sumireko Usami's smartphone in Urban Legend in Limbo.

In Urban Legend in Limbo, she takes on the urban legend of Mary-san,[1] a legend similar to the western Bloody Mary myth. Rather than wanting to be truly menacing, however, Koishi appeared to "join in on the fun" with the other characters also performing urban legends, eventually having to receive advice from Marisa Kirisame on how to make her urban legend scarier. She seemed genuinely happy that she was able to use her urban legend effectively, even if it was only on a single person.

Having purged herself of "worldly attachments," she's viewed as having achieved something akin to enlightenment by the Buddhists of the Myouren Temple, although they question whether or not the price she paid was in her best interests.

As her actions are controlled entirely by her unconscious, Koishi's presence cannot be noticed by other beings unless she allows it, even while standing in plain view because she's closed her mind, or her Third Eye. Likewise, her older sister's ability to read minds has no effect on her, as she does not technically have a mind to read, which is why she said "my sister can't win against me." Even someone who manages to communicate with Koishi will forget about her after she leaves, unless they already knew of her as Satori's sister.

Some children are immune to this effect due to their still-developing minds, leading Koishi to become their "imaginary friend", though they will forget about her when they grow up. Other than making others unable to perceive her existence, it also makes the act of doing so difficult to perceive. Practically, without being noticed by tengu or the other youkai, she climbed Youkai Mountain. However, as Satori's presence has been made generally known among the youkai of Gensokyo, Koishi has begun to be recognized by other residents as of late.

The youkai satori, on whom she and her older sister are based, by the actions of the humans' unconscious, they saw painful experiences. Due to this it is also not known if this ability was spoken of cynically in the past. However, since she closed her third eye which can read minds, she became unable to read others' minds. As she said herself, "reading people's minds is depressing, there's nothing good about it.".}}

2º ("Koishi Backstory")= {{To escape the fear and hatred which other beings feel towards the satori species, Koishi attempted to destroy her mind-reading ability by closing her Third Eye. However, this had the side effect of sealing away her own conscious mind, causing her to lose all thoughts and motives; she could no longer be hated, but neither could she be loved, or even remembered by people who saw her.}}

entries.name: Rin Kaenbyou
entries.content:
Rin Kaenbyou is an Kasha and pet of Satori Komeiji and Koishi Komeiji at the "palace of the earth spirits". Rin prefers to be called by her nickname "Orin"
As a Kasha, Orin is like an cat-like youkai and her function is to bring corpses of recent dead people to the underground to burn at the local where her best friend "Utsuho" menages nuclear energy.
Orin is very cheerful and playful, despite being kind of morbid in some of her jokes and topics few times. Also, Rin sometimes likes to see people fighting to see which one will die and then she pick this corpse and carry to the former hell in her rail cart.
Rin has red hair with two ponytails. She wears a black dress and has orange eyes. Orin has long red-tyed and sharp fingernails, resembling in her cat-claws. Also, Orin has two black cat ears and one cat tail.

entries.name: Utsuho Reiuji
entries.content:
Utsuho spell cards example are {Atomic Fire "Nuclear Fusion"}; {Atomic Fire "Nuclear Excursion"}; {Atomic Fire "Uncontainable Nuclear Reaction"}; {Explosion Sign "Petit Flare"}; {Explosion Sign "Mega Flare"}; {Explosion Sign "Giga Flare"}; {Explosion Sign "Peta Flare"}; {Blazing Star "Fixed Star"}; {Blazing Star "Planetary Revolution"}; {Blazing Star "Ten Evil Stars"}; {"Hell and Heaven Meltdown"}; {"Hell's Artificial Sun"}; {"Subterranean Sun"}; {Nuclear Sign "Creeping Sun"}.]

5º ("Utsuho Personality")= {{Utsuho has a simple and direct personality, it can even be said that she's airheaded. In fact, she misunderstood what Kanako Yasaka told her ("We can use that to bring about the wishes of not just the underground, but the above ground as well.") and believed that she had to use her new power to take over Gensokyo. Furthermore, when Sanae Kochiya told her that she is the shrine maiden that serves Kanako, Utsuho said she doesn't know that it's her; and after fighting, Utsuho didn't even remember the purpose of the fight and believes Sanae when she said that Utsuho was following Sanae's orders

Utsuho is often depicted as somewhat simple-minded and naïve. Her thought processes can be straightforward and childlike, which sometimes makes her appear less intelligent than her peers. This simplicity also contributes to her genuine and innocent nature.

She is highly loyal, particularly to her master, Satori Komeiji, and her friend, Rin Kaenbyou (Orin). Her obedience and dedication are evident in her willingness to follow orders, even when those orders lead her into potentially dangerous or morally ambiguous situations.

After gaining the power of nuclear fusion from Yatagarasu, Utsuho becomes somewhat obsessed with the idea of spreading her newfound power. However, her simplistic nature means she doesn’t fully grasp the potential consequences of her actions. This power hunger is not driven by malice but rather by a desire to fulfill her role as a powerful being.

She is filled with energy and enthusiasm, especially regarding her role in managing the Hell of Blazing Fires. Her ambitions, although somewhat misguided, are fueled by her boundless energy and desire to prove herself.

Utsuho displays a childlike curiosity about the world around her. This trait often leads her into trouble, as she can be easily manipulated or led astray by those who understand how to exploit her simple nature.

Despite her destructive capabilities and the potential threat she poses, Utsuho's intentions are not evil. She is a good-hearted character who simply lacks the understanding of how to properly channel her powers and ambitions. Her misguided actions stem more from ignorance than from any desire to cause harm.

Utsuho holds Satori in high regard and follows her commands diligently. She respects Satori’s wisdom and authority, even if she doesn't always fully understand her master's intentions.

Her friendship with Rin is a significant aspect of her character. Utsuho relies on Rin for guidance and often follows her lead. Their relationship is built on mutual trust and loyalty.

When interacting with other characters, especially those from the surface world, Utsuho can come across as intimidating due to her immense power. However, those who take the time to understand her often find a kind and well-meaning individual beneath the imposing exterior.

Utsuho is immensely powerful yet innocently naïve, ambitious yet simple-minded, and loyal yet easily led astray. Her childlike curiosity and good-hearted nature make her a lovable character despite the potential dangers her powers pose.

Utsuho's job is to manage the temperature inside the Hell of Blazing Fires, by either opening the skylight above the Hell of Blazing Fires's courtyard to lower the temperature, or feeding the fires with the corpses carried by Orin at the "Remains of Blazing Hell".

Her abilities come from the god of nuclear fusion, Yatagarasu, and were granted to her by Kanako Yasaka in the god's attempt to turn the Hell of Blazing Fires into an energy source for Gensokyo. After absorbing the god, Utsuho obtained the left leg "the leg of fission" and the right leg "the leg of fusion", along with the third leg (a nuclear control rod in her right hand). As a result, she is able to manipulate the ultimate energy, nuclear fusion. Essentially, this means that Utsuho's own body actually houses a divine spirit, technically making her into a branch shrine for Yatagarasu. Apparently, the duller the holder of the power, the better they can utilize it. The red eye on her chest is proof that Utsuho obtained the power of fusion by absorbing Yatagarasu because the god's eyes are red, according to Chapter Three of Cage in Lunatic Runagate.

In the outside world, the prospects of putting this to use have still not been reached, and thus can surely be said to be an illusionary power.

Yatagarasu is the Misaki God of the Nihon Shinwa. In Nihon Shoki, as the messenger and envoy of highest sun god of the Nihon Shinwa, Amaterasu Oomikami (天照大神), Yatagarasu is considered the incarnation of the sun. It has been said that Yatagarasu possibly lives in the sun.

That is, it means that she's able to manipulate the same temperature as the the highest heating power in the natural world, the sun (Furthermore, by the spells that she uses, she is also able to spring forth the same gravitational attraction). However, Utsuho can't keep creating energy forever on her own because she would run out of "fusion material" and as explained in one of the endings for Subterranean Animism incidents, she needs to get the atoms used in the fusion process from someone else.}}

entries.name: Satori species
entries.content: Satori (覚) is a type of mountain-dwelling youkai in Japanese folklore that is known to live within the mountains of Hida and Mino (today's Gifu Prefecture). They are famous for being the youkai that are able to read human thoughts. Satori are said to approach travelers on mountain paths in hominid form and speak their thoughts aloud.

entries.name: Remains of Hell
entries.content:
The Remains of Blazing Hell (灼熱地獄跡 Shakunetsu Jigoku Ato), also known as the Hell of Blazing Fires (灼熱地獄 Shakunetsu Jigoku) and Remains of Hell (地獄跡地 Jigoku Atochi, lit. "Abandoned Site of Hell"), is thought to be in the deepest part of the Underworld, located below Former Hell and the Palace of the Earth Spirits.

The Remains of Blazing Hell was formerly a part of Former Hell where criminals were banished, it has recently been re-ignited because of the activation of the Nuclear Furnace directly below by Utsuho Reiuji. Rin Kaenbyou can be found here, carting corpses into the Furnace to keep it running. The place is very hot because it has a lot of magma, and it is invested with vengeful spirits. Since people stopped being condemned to the hellfires, the oni don't visit any more either, so this place has become the playground to such spirits and animals. It's said that if you die here, your corpse will be trapped here and you'll turn into a vengeful spirit, where you cannot make it to Heaven regardless of your innocence.

Before the events of Subterranean Animism, the Blazing Fires were apparently not as hot as it is now, because when Hell moved to a new location that in itself created Former Hell, the Blazing Fires started to cool down, thus becoming dark, and Satori Komeiji sealed it off with the Palace of the Earth Spirits. Thus, this became space for Kanako Yasaka and Suwako Moriya to start a Mountain Industrial Revolution project, and Utsuho burned it up again after she swallowed the god Yatagarasu.

entries.name: Underworld
entries.content:
